status: Written before examining any experimental outcomes; exploratory benchmark, not an external preregistration.
seeding: Same randomly chosen known-positive document for every method in a topic/seed pair; seed counts as one review; discovery/search cost excluded.
topic_selection: Selected before any model runs for legal/judicial, performance, insolvency/liquidity, ownership changes and crime/law enforcement; no selection based on model results.
temporary_negatives: 100 random unreviewed documents, resampled each fit, never persisted as true labels
inference: Descriptive within-collection results. No significance or superiority claim across legal matters or IST leads.
stopping: Fixed 5000-document budget, independent of hidden labels. Unreached recall thresholds remain censored.

extensions.explore_10: Use 10% random exploration for batches of at least 10
